name: Soft Mayfly 11
author: Mike11jr
description: Dark cyan button that lifts and glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, border-radius becomes 5px, transform becomes translateY(-10px), box-shadow becomes 0 7px 0 -2px #f85959,
  0 15px 0 -4px #39a2db,
  0 16px 10px -3px #39a2db.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Soft Mayfly 11</title>
<style>
/* Soft Mayfly 11 by Mike11jr — https://uiverse.io/Mike11jr/soft-mayfly-11 */
.btn {
 width: 130px;
 height: 40px;
 font-size: 1.1em;
 cursor: pointer;
 background-color: #171717;
 color: #fff;
 border: none;
 border-radius: 5px;
 transition: all .4s;
}

.btn:hover {
 border-radius: 5px;
 transform: translateY(-10px);
 box-shadow: 0 7px 0 -2px #f85959,
  0 15px 0 -4px #39a2db,
  0 16px 10px -3px #39a2db;
}

.btn:active {
 transition: all 0.2s;
 transform: translateY(-5px);
 box-shadow: 0 2px 0 -2px #f85959,
  0 8px 0 -4px #39a2db,
  0 12px 10px -3px #39a2db;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="btn">Hover Me!
</button>

</body>
</html>
